assets.description: The Zagedan lakes are of ancient glacial origin. The glacier retreated about 11,000 years ago, leaving behind the landscape we see today. Zagedan Valley with high-altitude lakes. Karachay-Cherkessia, Caucasus Mountains, Russia.
